svg.title: Who writes the memory, and when
svg.desc: A timeline of two conversations with a gap between them, and four rows, one per kind of writer. Nobody: the raw messages are kept as they arrive, and nothing is lost or cleaned up, so old and new values both stay. A pipeline: an extraction call runs after each message or at the end of the session; it loses what its prompt does not ask for. The answering agent: it writes with a tool call inside its own turn, while the user waits; it loses what it does not decide to write. A background process: it runs later, between the conversations; it can rewrite or drop what it should keep, and its result is not ready until it has run.
svg.text: Who writes the memory, and when
